_meta.why_no_replicas: Single-node cluster. A replica can never be assigned, so every index sat yellow with an unassigned shard - 481 of them by 2026-09-02, doubling shard count for nothing.
_meta.why_keyword: service/category/origin/log_level are filtered and aggregated on, never full-text searched. keyword skips the analyzer and keeps the doc_values that make Kibana's filters fast.
_meta.why_parse_origination_date: The index name comes from the event's own @timestamp, not from today - so a filebeat that lost its registry and re-read three months of container logs creates indices dated back to June. Without this, ILM would age them from their creation date and keep every one of them for a further fourteen days. With it, min_age counts from the date in the name and the backfill expires on contact.
